description: OLX classified listings search (Poland, Romania, Portugal, Ukraine, Bulgaria, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan) from OLX's public listing API: title, URL, price with currency and negotiable flag, city/region, category ID, posted and refreshed dates, private vs business seller, photo URL, short description and promotion flags, plus the total number of matching ads. Newest first by default. Related tools on this server, for a different need: ecommerce_aliexpress when you need AliExpress product search from the public search page; ecommerce_faire when you need Faire wholesale marketplace category listing: product. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
